authority: Issue #590; funded scholarly work, owner-delegated science defaults. Coefficient is gameplay accounting, not measured historical productivity.

corpora.title: Systema Naturae (1735), published Latin classification and consistent names
A Voyage to Jamaica (1707/1725), published English observations and descriptions

targets.activity: Compare published descriptions across Latin and English, translate observed terms and reconcile consistent specimen terminology in written reference tables.

historicalRationale: Natural historians compared published descriptions and names across languages. These already published works support translation and terminology checking at a commissioned center; comparative linguistic methods improve this paid task, not every kind of research. This is paid adoption, not a claim that either author practiced later comparative linguistics.
materialBill: Existing commissioning pays 120 treasury minor units and two real local cloth units, with seven preparation days, for instruments, specimen cases, recording tools and reference-copy consultation/procurement. The authored published corpus is part of this paid reference kit, never a research grant. Each funded day still consumes one local cloth for records/wrapping and one treasury unit for assistants and translation/reference work. Full target research payment is unchanged and separate.
rules: Requires lawful administration >=40, positive capacity, accessible scholarly center and commissioned equipment. Only targets with every authored source-language/corpus pair qualify. Research grants no corpus, equipment, specimens, discovery or translation of hidden campaign information.
stacking: Add this named 400 bp source once to qualified Calculus 500 and Chemical Classification 400 before the existing single fractional work calculation. 109 becomes 113 daily work; 9000 completes in 83 versus 80 funded days.
persistence: No new saved state. Corpus requirements are immutable definitions of the existing paid equipment kit. Existing equipment, pending target/full payment, work, remainder and committed day remain authoritative; existing legacy migration grants no work or equipment.
